profile.raw_yaml:
# 口径卡（故障注入：慢节点）：3 个提供者经 ZooKeeper 发现，开环 5000 req/s、60s；第 2 个提供者经 toxiproxy，
# 20s 时在它的回包方向加 latency 20ms（jitter 5ms），40s 时移除。负载均衡 roundrobin（不感知负载的基线）。
# 与 fault-slow-node-p2c-v1 只差 target.load_balance。对照 = 同卡 --no-faults（不另建卡）。
# 跑法：TOXIPROXY_API=http://127.0.0.1:8475 TOXIPROXY_UPSTREAM_HOST=127.0.0.1 TOXIPROXY_LISTEN_HOST=127.0.0.1 TOXIPROXY_PORT_BASE=21000 \n#   bench/bin/fault-run.sh --card fault-slow-node-rr-v1 --behind-toxiproxy all [--no-faults]（原生 toxiproxy 的起法见 docs/benchmarking.md「故障注入」）
#   （三个提供者都经代理：代理路径本身的开销对三个节点对称，只有第 2 个加 toxic）。故障时刻相对本轮开始（预热段之后）。
# 改动口径请复制成新 id（-v2），不要原地改。
profile: fault-slow-node-rr-v1
question: 3 个提供者、开环 5000 req/s，其中一个节点变慢 20ms 时，roundrobin 负载均衡给它的份额与整体 p99；移除后份额多快恢复
target:
  transport: rpc
  service: BenchService#echo
  payload: { kind: bytes, size: 1024 }
  serializer: protobuf
  providers: 3
  load_balance: roundrobin
load:
  model: open
  rate: 5000
  faults:
    - { at: 20s, kind: toxic-latency, target: 2, latency: 20ms, jitter: 5ms }
    - { at: 40s, kind: remove-toxic, target: 2 }
  duration: 60s
  warmup: 10s
  steady_window: [10s, 60s]
  rounds: 1
  timeout: 1s
isolation:
  client_process: separate_jvm
  server_process: separate_jvm
  same_host: true
  registry: docker-compose/zookeeper（容器未绑核、与压测进程共享宿主核）；三个提供者都经 toxiproxy 原生进程（同 WSL，2.13.0，二进制取自 compose 镜像；只有第 2 个加 toxic）
measure:
  histogram: { significant_digits: 3, max: 10s }
  report: [throughput, p50, p99, p999, max, errors_by_status]

run.command: rpc-bench-e2e run --profile /home/yifan/rpc-bench/bench/profiles/fault-slow-node-rr-v1.yaml --registry zk://127.0.0.1:2181 --out /home/yifan/t19/p/slow/rr-off-2 --label outlier-probe --topology /home/yifan/t19/p/slow/rr-off-2/topology.txt --fault-schedule /home/yifan/t19/p/slow/rr-off-2/schedule-141819.txt --open-workers per-request --outlier-detection off --pin-dispatcher 5

server_environment.server_executor: fixed pool (10 threads, queue 1000): business methods run off the IO threads

scheduler.call_style: sync proxy method on a new virtual thread per request

io.source: /proc/self/io (syscr, syscw) + sum of /proc/self/task/*/status (voluntary / nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches), grouped by /proc/self/task/*/comm prefix (by_group), steady window

backpressure.source: server stats (RpcServer.autoReadPauses / outboundOverloadRejections) + harness client (RpcClient.sendBufferRejections / unwritableConnectionSwitches)

server_executor.source: server counters (RpcServer.executorRejections / shutdownRejections / queuedBusinessTasks; queue wait = bench QueueWaitFilter: arrival (IO-thread decode) -> business thread starts the filter chain)

timeline.basis: success / errors / latency by completion time (latency from the scheduled send time, 2 significant digits); node_attempts / retries from the harness RpcClient (attempts incl. retries, by send time); ejected_nodes = providers in outlier ejection at the end of the second, ejections / restores = cumulative outlier ejections / restores at the end of the second; server_* from each provider's counters() sampled every second (delta of two samples)

recovery.criterion: first second s >= floor(event) where errors[s..s+2] == 0; recovery = max(0, s - event); no error at all after the event = 0
first second s >= floor(event) where errors[s..s+2] == 0; recovery = max(0, s - event); no error at all after the event = 0

summary.selection_rule: 开环：窗口 p99 的中位数那一轮

statements: 开环负载（open）：延迟从计划发出时刻算起，发压端自身的调度滞后（见“发出滞后”列）也计入延迟；发出滞后的 p99 明显大于服务时间时，说明压测端本身成了瓶颈，数字不代表被测服务。
开环调度线程以忙等对齐节拍，独占一个核；本报告的 CPU 亲和见环境表。
第 1 轮发出滞后 p99 超过 1.0ms（dispatcher_delayed）。故障注入 / 阶梯卡上这条规则只记标志、不判无效：这类卡看的是错误数、恢复时间与节点份额，它们不受几毫秒的发出滞后影响；本轮的延迟数字（含 p99）混进了压测端的滞后，仅供参考。
错误不计入延迟分布与吞吐；延迟分位数只统计完成时刻落在统计窗口内的成功调用。
validity.topology: client 与 server 是两个独立 JVM，同一台机器（loopback），3 个提供者（[127.0.0.1:21001, 127.0.0.1:21002, 127.0.0.1:21003]），经 zk://127.0.0.1:2181 发现；卡片声明的注册中心：docker-compose/zookeeper（容器未绑核、与压测进程共享宿主核）；三个提供者都经 toxiproxy 原生进程（同 WSL，2.13.0，二进制取自 compose 镜像；只有第 2 个加 toxic）。
